packages.section: Game-boy's request in this brief (the player's straight punches land palm-down), within Part A A20
packages.note: THE CHANGE. The player's straight punches are game/actors/placeholder_poses.gd _jab_1 (the left jab) and _jab_2 (the right cross; _dummy_jab reuses it). Today, at full extension the fist is vertical: the curled fingers face inward, toward the other hand. Game-boy wants it to turn 90 degrees over the punch, so at contact the palm faces the ground and the curled fingers angle down (a corkscrew punch, the knuckles forward and the back of the hand up). STEP 1: measure today's orientation at the strike key with numbers (the hand bone's palm normal and finger-curl direction in the player's frame, both hands) and decide which way pronation turns each hand. STEP 2: re-roll the forearm and hand in _jab_1's and _jab_2's strike (and the wind-up only if the turn needs to start there) so the fist turns about 90 degrees from the wind-up to contact and lands palm-down. Split the twist between LowerArm and Hand as real forearm pronation does, so the hero's skinned wrist and elbow don't candy-wrap: check the art's strain at those keys (A7, tests/art_strain.gd and tests/fixtures/strain/strain_ratchet.json) and the wrist and wrap in first person. CONSTRAINTS: every FistPoint (the hitbox) stays within A20's 1 cm of today at every key, so the strike reach envelope (tests/test_humanoid_rig.gd), the hits and M3's tuning are unchanged; the first-person framing tests (test_humanoid_rig's FP share bars, test_art_player's A9 ratchets) stay green or move by a logged old -> new figure; the training dummy's jab still reads. Regenerate tests/fixtures/motion/move_clip_hashes.json with gen_clip_hashes.tscn and add a reason note as call 24 did (the lead regenerates it again after merging F-fist-turn), and the strain and M3-deformation fixtures if your change moves them (their gen_*.tscn; old -> new). ADD tests/test_punch_turn.gd: at the strike key of the jab and the cross, each fist's palm faces down (within about 20 degrees) and its curled fingers point down; and the wind-up is no more than about 30 degrees turned (it really turns over the punch). It must fail on today's poses. LOOK in first person: record 'Look: my arms and legs' (pa1) and C8 'Look: own limbs' on the hero, and take full-resolution stills of the jab and the cross from wind-up to contact beside the same frames recorded before your change; also C4 'Look: Punk attacks at 1 m' is the Punk's and not yours. You own: _jab_1 and _jab_2 in game/actors/placeholder_poses.gd, tests/test_punch_turn.gd (new), tests/fixtures/motion/move_clip_hashes.json, tests/fixtures/strain/strain_ratchet.json and tests/fixtures/motion/m3_deformation.json (regenerated only), figures your change moves in tests/test_art_player.gd, tests/test_humanoid_rig.gd and tests/test_m4_done_when.gd (old -> new, with a twin), docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (one line where the player's strikes are described) and your calls file. Run the full suite (green, 0 SCRIPT ERROR, SHADER ERROR or ERROR). Done: at contact in first person both straight punches land palm-down with the curled fingers toward the ground, the turn reads as a natural corkscrew without a wrist or elbow twist, and the hits are unchanged.
